Rikhi: 'Bachcha gharb ke andar thaili mein hota hai. Isliye sambhog ka sidha asar bachche per nahin hota vaise patni ko taklif dekar SAMBHOG nahin karna chahiye. Pati ku apna vajan patnikc pet par nahin lana chahiye bachche ke junése use saalwen mahinc ke siya sambhog hargiz nahin karna chahiye.' Aadmi: 'Dr. Bachchc ke janam ke baad sambhog kab shuru karna chahiye' Rikhi: 'Bachchc kc janam ke 6 hafton baad sambhog karnemcin koi harj nahin.' Aadmi: 'Dr. Saheb, aapke khayal mein raat ka khana khane ke baad kab SAMBHOG karna chhahiye?' Rikhi: 'Khane ke do ghante baad sambhog karna uchcha hai kuin ki sambhog mein shariirka pura khoon bhug leta hai achha SAMBHOG shantipurvak hona chahiye.'

Dialogue: Ladki: 'Dusre mulkon incin nudist camp hotc liain jahan stree purush samuhi sc nanga rahate hain. Kya un logonki sharam nahi aati hogi?' Rikhi: 'Kudrat ne insaan ko nanga paida kiya hai is jahan main aakar unhonc kapda pahanana sikha hai, Bharat min jangali jatiyon aaj bhi rahati hai jo ki nangi rahati hai nudist kamp mein yoh memt hai jinke nanga hona kudrat lagta hai aagar unko sharam hati hai yeh aisa nahin karte. Yeh jawab unse puchhe to achcha hai.' Aadmi: 'Maine padha hai bahar ke mulkon mein kuchh dostijode milkar samuhik sambhog karte hain kya yeh baat thựck hai?' Rikhi: 'Jo mard aur aurat milkar samuhik sambhog karte hain usse anek aur laingik bikrutiyan paida ho sakti hain samaj isso morel samjti hai.' Ladki: 'Meri ek bees saal ki saheli ne mujhe bataya ki jab uska pati uski thigh aur clitoris chumta hai to orgasm pati isse koi nuksaan to nahin hota?' Rikhi: 'Nahin, agar chhut ki bimari ho isse koyi nuksaan nahin hota. Achcha ab gapno asli maksad par ad jaye. Jindagi mein sam bhoy ka ck anpa alag mahatva hota hai lekin shadi ke kamyab banane ke liye dusri baat ki bhi zaroorat hoti hai jiska ayan dena logon ko nihayat zarroori hai.'
